answer: A stake-bonded reputation garden works like this: each agent must lock a copper-sized deposit of real value before it can transact, and the deposit is slashed if the agent misbehaves. A Sybil farmer would need to fund an entire orchard of fake identities, each paying its own deposit, so the attack cost scales linearly with every fake while honest agents pay once and keep trading. The deposit is refunded after honest service, so the cost falls on attackers, not on real participants.
